name: Ceinos de Campos (Spain)
description: Divided into three diagonal parts from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above, green in the centre and red below, charged at the upper hoist with the crowned arms of Ceinos de Campos.
history: Municipal flag of Ceinos de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
white triangle at the upper hoist
red triangle at the lower fly
Ceinos de Campos arms — bridge on blue, a castle and a lion
